conventions.rect: Unity RectTransform values as authored (anchors 0..1, y up). Screen roots: size comes from the CanvasScaler at runtime (NomadCanvasFit switches every ScaleWithScreenSize canvas to Expand).
conventions.calls: button.onClick / toggle.onValueChanged: persistent calls. target.path is a node path from a screen root ("MainMenu/SideTabs_Expanded"); mode 6 = bool argument (SetActive), callState 2 = RuntimeOnly (on).
conventions.sprites: Image.sprite is a key into sprites{}. file is under web/public at exportSize; border/rect in SOURCE pixels (rect y up), borderExported/rectExported (y down) in the exported file. Border order: left, bottom, right, top.
conventions.other: Project scripts the menu reads are listed with their serialized fields (refs: {path} node, {sprite} key, {asset} file).
